clips.caption:
Her husband's dream was the one thing she wanted him to drop.

Kevin Trudeau tells the part of the Ray Kroc story you see in the movie. Ray's wife talked down to him. She wasn't his cheerleader, she wasn't proud of him, and she was unhappy with his failures.

She wanted him to live a normal life and stop chasing dreams. Kevin calls her a dream stealer, someone trying to take Ray's dream away.

Has anyone ever tried to talk you out of a dream?
